The migration is complete. The build passes with all routes properly recognized. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Migration Summary

### Deleted
- Entire `pages/` directory (9 files)
- `components/AppProvider.js` (replaced with `.tsx`)

### Created - App Router Structure

| File | Replaces | Key Changes |
|---|---|---|
| `app/layout.tsx` | `_app.js` + `_document.js` | Root layout with `<html>`/`<body>`, `metadata` export replaces `<Head>`, imports global CSS |
| `app/page.tsx` | `pages/index.js` | Server Component using `headers()` instead of `getServerSideProps`, `fetch` with `cache: "no-store"` for dynamic SSR, `metadata` export |
| `app/blog/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/index.js` | Server Component with `export const revalidate = 60` replacing `getStaticProps` + ISR |
| `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `pages/blog/[id].js` | `generateStaticParams` replaces `getStaticPaths`, `generateMetadata` for dynamic `<Head>`, `notFound()` for missing posts |
| `app/not-found.tsx` | `pages/404.js` | App Router not-found boundary (no client-side router needed) |
| `app/error.tsx` | `pages/_error.js` | `"use client"` error boundary with `reset()` |
| `app/global-error.tsx` | *(new)* | Catches root layout errors |
| `app/api/posts/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/index.js` | Route Handler with `GET`/`POST` exports, `Response.json()` instead of `res.status().json()` |
| `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` | `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | Route Handler with `params: Promise<{id}>`, `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE` exports |

### Created - Client Components (extracted from pages that used hooks)
| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `components/AppProvider.tsx` | Typed `"use client"` context provider |
| `components/NavigateToBlogButton.tsx` | `useRouter().push("/blog")` |
| `components/ReadMoreButton.tsx` | `useRouter().push(\`/blog/${id}\`)` |
| `components/BackButton.tsx` | `useRouter().back()` |

### Key API replacements
- `next/head` → `metadata` / `generateMetadata` exports
- `next/router` → `next/navigation` (in client components)
- `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `headers()`
- `getStaticProps` + `revalidate` → async Server Component + `export const revalidate`
- `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`
- `pages/api/*.js` (req/res handlers) → `app/api/*/route.ts` (Web API `Request`/`Response`)
- `Html`/`Head`/`Main`/`NextScript` → root `layout.tsx` with native `<html>`/`<body>`
- `Error.getInitialProps` → `error.tsx` client boundary with `reset()`
